MUSIC AND DANCE — TERMLY EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: MUSIC AND DANCE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Brown, pink, and gold
   B. Black, white, and grey
   C. Green, orange, and purple
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

2. Best practice when working on Dance Production: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Dance Production.
   B. Practise Dance Production with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Dance Production.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Dance Production.

3. Best practice when working on Kenyan Indigenous Musical Instruments 2.4 Western Musical Instruments 2.5 Contem: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Indigenous Musical Instruments 2.4 Western Musical Instruments 2.5 Contem.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Indigenous Musical Instruments 2.4 Western Musical Instruments 2.5 Contem.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Indigenous Musical Instruments 2.4 Western Musical Instruments 2.5 Contem.
   D. Practise Kenyan Indigenous Musical Instruments 2.4 Western Musical Instruments 2.5 Contem with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. Best practice when working on Kenyan Folk Songs: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Folk Songs.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Folk Songs.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Folk Songs.
   D. Practise Kenyan Folk Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. Best practice when working on Setting Text to Music: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Setting Text to Music.
   B. Damage equipment used for Setting Text to Music.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Setting Text to Music.
   D. Practise Setting Text to Music with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The speed of the music
   B. Only the costume
   C. Only the volume
   D. The ticket price

7. Best practice when working on Melody in Major Keys: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Melody in Major Keys.
   B. Practise Melody in Major Keys with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Melody in Major Keys.
   D. Damage equipment used for Melody in Major Keys.

8. Best practice when working on Music Notation Software: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Music Notation Software.
   B. Practise Music Notation Software with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Music Notation Software.
   D. Damage equipment used for Music Notation Software.

9. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Guarantee a trophy
   B. Replace drinking water
   C. Remove the need for rules
   D. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

10. Best practice when working on Kenyan Folk Songs 2.2 Western Style Solo Songs 2.3 Kenyan Indigenous Musical Ins: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Kenyan Folk Songs 2.2 Western Style Solo Songs 2.3 Kenyan Indigenous Musical Ins with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Folk Songs 2.2 Western Style Solo Songs 2.3 Kenyan Indigenous Musical Ins.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Folk Songs 2.2 Western Style Solo Songs 2.3 Kenyan Indigenous Musical Ins.
   D. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Folk Songs 2.2 Western Style Solo Songs 2.3 Kenyan Indigenous Musical Ins.

11. Best practice when working on Two-Part Harmony Two-part harmony guidelines;: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Two-Part Harmony Two-part harmony guidelines;.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Two-Part Harmony Two-part harmony guidelines;.
   C. Practise Two-Part Harmony Two-part harmony guidelines; with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Two-Part Harmony Two-part harmony guidelines;.

12. Best practice when working on Music Notation Software 1.7 Dance Production 2.0 Performing 2.1 Kenyan Folk Song: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Music Notation Software 1.7 Dance Production 2.0 Performing 2.1 Kenyan Folk Song.

   C. Practise Music Notation Software 1.7 Dance Production 2.0 Performing 2.1 Kenyan Folk Song with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Music Notation Software 1.7 Dance Production 2.0 Performing 2.1 Kenyan Folk Song.

13. Best practice when working on Transposition: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Transposition.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Transposition.
   C. Practise Transposition with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Transposition.

14. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.
   B. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.
   C. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.

15. Best practice when working on Western Style Solo Songs: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Western Style Solo Songs.
   B. Practise Western Style Solo Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Western Style Solo Songs.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Western Style Solo Songs.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Western Style Solo Songs and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Kenyan Indigenous Musical Instruments 2.4 Western Musical Instruments 2.5 Contem and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Kenyan Indigenous Musical Instrument Indigenous musical instruments (fiddle, lyr and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Western Musical Instruments 2.5 Contemporary Dances-Kenyan 3.0 Critical Apprecia and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Western Musical Instruments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Contemporary Dances-Kenyan 3.0 Critical Appreciation 3.1 Kenyan Folk Songs 3.2 C and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
